title: MBABench-2.0: Evaluating AI Agents on Constructing Financial Spreadsheets Beyond Simple Verifiability
abstract: arXiv:2610.31711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spreadsheets are the lingua franca of modern finance, driving valuation, forecast, audit, and many other core workflows of the industry. As LLM agents advance to automate knowledge work, spreadsheet construction is a natural and pertinent testbed. However, most existing spreadsheet benchmarks evaluate agents on fill-in-the-blank style tasks, where an agent performs minor edits in otherwise complete spreadsheets. This protocol fails to capture the most central and time-consuming part of the spreadsheet workflow: the modeling decisions, format design, and sheet layout regular knowledge workers need to toil through to build a workbook from scratch. We introduce MBABench-2.0, a benchmark of 101 original spreadsheet construction tasks, the hardest of which is estimated to take 33 hours for a modeler with 3+ years of experience. translated_title: MBABench-2.0：超越简单可验证性，评估AI智能体构建财务电子表格的能力
translated_abstract: 电子表格是现代金融领域的通用语言，支撑着估值、预测、审计以及该行业的众多核心工作流程。随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体在知识工作自动化方面不断进步，电子表格构建成为一个自然而贴切的测试平台。然而，大多数现有的电子表格基准测试采用填空式任务来评估智能体，即智能体在基本完整的电子表格中进行少量编辑。这种评估协议未能捕捉到电子表格工作流程中最核心且最耗时的部分：普通知识工作者从零开始构建工作簿时需要费力完成的建模决策、格式设计和表格布局。我们推出了MBABench-2.0，这是一个包含101个原创电子表格构建任务的基准测试，其中最难的任务预计需要具有3年以上经验的建模者花费33小时才能完成。与编程或数学领域不同——在那些领域中，单元测试或最终答案即可验证智能体的输出——财务电子表格的质量
tldr: 该论文提出MBABench-2.0基准测试，包含101个从零构建财务电子表格的原创任务，突破了以往填空式简单可验证任务的局限，用于更真实地评估AI智能体完成建模决策、格式设计和表格布局等核心电子表格构建工作的能力。
en_tdlr: MBABench-2.0 introduces a benchmark of 101 original financial spreadsheet construction tasks that go beyond simple verifiability to evaluate AI agents on the most central and time-consuming aspects of spreadsheet workflows, such as modeling decisions, format design, and sheet layout.
